decisions.reason: After surviving the first review cycle, this carpet benefits from added sunk design and marketing investment, but as a relatively standard product in a category already pruned in 2024 it remains the most exposed to further range rationalization.

The hand-knotted wool-silk carpet matches the firm's craftsmanship and fine-material positioning, so management is likely to continue justifying the visible commitment unless demand clearly disappoints.
The corner bench extends the core furniture business and can serve both private and project interiors, making continued support easy to defend as part of the established direction.

The swivel shell chair line represents the strongest public commitment because it is a multi-model line and fits the firm's stated push toward flexible workplace concepts, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it.
